projects.title: Nova Finance
projects.description: Complete rebrand and web platform redesign for a next-generation fintech company.
projects.challenge: Nova Finance needed to establish themselves as a modern, trustworthy fintech player in a crowded market. Their existing visual identity felt outdated and their website wasn't converting qualified leads.
projects.solution: We developed a comprehensive rebrand including logo, design system, and website rebuild. The new platform emphasizes security, simplicity, and transparency with an intuitive interface that guides users through complex financial concepts.
projects.results: Successfully launched rebrand with 40% increase in qualified leads within first 3 months.

projects.title: Motion Studio
projects.description: Portfolio website for a motion graphics and video production studio.
projects.challenge: Motion Studio needed a website that showcased their creative work while being performant and SEO-friendly.
projects.solution: Built a video-first portfolio with custom video streaming, lazy loading optimization, and a focus on visual storytelling.
projects.results: Achieved 98 Lighthouse performance score and tripled portfolio inquiries.

projects.title: Flow Operations
projects.description: Custom AI automation solution for streamlining business operations and reducing manual work.
projects.challenge: Flow Operations was spending 40+ hours per week on repetitive manual tasks across different tools and systems.
projects.solution: We built a custom AI automation platform that integrates with their existing tools, uses machine learning to optimize workflows, and provides real-time reporting and insights.
projects.results: Reduced manual work by 85%, saving 30+ hours per week and improving accuracy to 99.2%.

projects.title: Luxe Commerce
projects.description: High-end e-commerce platform for luxury fashion and accessories with premium UX.

projects.title: AI Content Hub

projects.title: Healthcare Portal
projects.description: HIPAA-compliant patient portal with appointment scheduling and telemedicine integration.
projects.challenge: Healthcare providers needed a secure, compliant patient portal that didn't require extensive IT support.
projects.solution: Built a HIPAA-compliant portal with end-to-end encryption, audit logging, and seamless integration with existing hospital systems.
projects.results: Deployed across 12 healthcare facilities serving 50,000+ patients securely.
